# Pinned agent read-model fixture

Source: https://github.com/ARA-Labs/Agent-Native-Research-Artifact/tree/e52a925e9d03b4ada3008653e72f99b04116fca2/examples/the-ara-of-ara

Full revision: `e52a925e9d03b4ada3008653e72f99b04116fca2` (local source HEAD verified; remote revision confirmed by the implementation coordinator via GitHub API).

Copied from `examples/the-ara-of-ara` without rewriting artifact content. Upstream license: MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Orchestra Research. See LICENSE.

Published field inventory: claims use Statement, Status, Provenance, Falsification criteria, Proof, Dependencies, Tags. The current skill also publishes Falsification; the reader accepts both without altering source labels. Heuristics use Rationale, Provenance, Sensitivity, Code ref, plus later published specialized fields retained in source_fields. Experiments use bare bold Status, Evidence output, Question, Setup, Prediction (directional) or Predictions (directional), Falsification condition. Observation promotion destinations include prose (for example O02); these are preserved and diagnosed rather than silently converted into canonical destinations. Session index rows use timestamp or date, and some rows point at absent session records. There is no taste_log.yaml in this revision; taste behavior is exercised by synthetic fixtures.
